CustomField.description: Link to Related Record based on RelatedObject, RelatedName, Id
CustomField.formula: IF(acheck__RelatedId__c = null, acheck__RelatedObject__c, HYPERLINK('/' & acheck__RelatedId__c, IF(ISBLANK(acheck__RelatedName__c), acheck__RelatedObject__c, acheck__RelatedName__c), 'source'))
CustomField.label: Related
